title: Analyzing the Analysts: When Do Recommendations Add Value?
one_line: Analysts favour glamour stocks (momentum, growth, high volume, high valuations); recommendation levels only predict returns for stocks with good quant traits (value, positive momentum), and the quarterly CHANGE in consensus is the more robust predictor.

findings.statement: Consensus level predicts returns only for value / positive-momentum stocks; for the rest, higher ratings → weaker returns.
Quarterly change in consensus is a robust, incremental predictor.

reported_results.headline: Analysts favour glamour stocks (momentum, growth, high volume, high valuations); recommendation levels only predict returns for stocks with good quant traits (value, positive momentum), and the quarterly CHANGE in consensus is the more robust predictor.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 4), not by the weekly pipeline.
